name: Legal Restrictions 2 Code
definition: Specifies the regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.

JURO.name: Jurisdiction Ownership
JURO.definition: Investors outside this jurisdiction can purchase this security, for example, a Reg S security can only be held by an investor outside the US.

PPLA.name: Private Placements
PPLA.definition: Only investors qualified by the issuer in this jurisdiction may purchase this security.

ACRI.name: Accredited Investor
ACRI.definition: Only investors qualified by the regulator in this jurisdiction may purchase this security.

MARG.name: Margin
MARG.definition: Issuer defines whether the security may be purchased with borrowed money (US and Japan).

PRIV.name: Privilege
PRIV.definition: Privileges, for example, voting rights, of holding the security may be restricted by the issuer.
